scope: saved-asset cost allocation and fixed observed utility; no inference/solver execution
deadline_rule: middle of the three registered cold deadlines; illustrative display, not outcome-selected optimum
fit_asset_match: fit-card candidate status=fitted, sha256 and absolute asset path match A allocator in authenticated A004 config; historical directory B5 is not the final B5 comparator
preparation_formula: selected candidate fit_wall_ns / 1e9 / N; B0 learned-fitting-operation component=0 only
complete_extra_preparation_A_minus_B0: unavailable; no attribution of shared collection, search/tuning, failed/pre-fix work, setup or unknown tails; selected component is not a bound on total difference
cold_request_formula: saved wall_including_publication_ns / 1e9 / physical_attempts, separately for A/B0 at the stated deadline; unchanged across N
utility_formula: saved all-scope population-weighted utility for A/B0 and their point difference at stated deadline; unchanged across N
uncertainty: copy the registered primary A–B0 frontier effect and simultaneous interval unchanged, never reinterpret as a deadline interval or narrow with N
limits: one genuine fit,60 original templates,two timing repeats
no warm-service forecast or utility-to-seconds exchange
no speedup/saving or break-even reuse claim
